name: sense-mcp
description: A local-first MCP context broker for bounded, consent-gated situational awareness.
author: Chris DiMarco

scripts.smoke:ci: d=$(mktemp -d /tmp/sense-smoke.XXXXXX); SENSE_BROKER_SOCKET=$d/b.sock SENSE_BROKER_IDLE_MS=2000 SENSE_MOCK=1 SENSE_LEDGER_DISABLED=1 SENSE_LEDGER_PATH=$d/ledger.jsonl SENSE_POLICY_PATH=$d/policy.json SENSE_CONSENT_DIR=$d/consent SENSE_SNAPSHOT_DIR=$d/snapshots SENSE_PANEL_RUNTIME_DIR=$d/panel node scripts/smoke.cjs; rc=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $rc
scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/SenseIOS/SenseIOS.xcodeproj -scheme SenseIOS -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run eval:routing && npm run eval:prompt-pack && npm run audit:prod && npm run audit:all
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run check && npm run check:package
